chunks: Whoever dies on the way to Makkah, going or returning, will be safe from the Great Terror on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْفَزَعِ الْأَكْبَرِ: the greatest terror and dread of the Hereafter
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred destination of pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for someone who dies on the way to or from Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a great merit for one who dies while traveling in connection with Makkah. It promises safety from the Great Terror on the Day of Resurrection for the one who dies either going to it or returning from it.
